sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop): a boxer's run, the gauntlets up in front of her, the LEGS CHANGING OVER
sheets.weapons: HER GAUNTLETS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the two big gold hextech gauntlets with their steel knuckles and blue cores, as big as in image 1, raised, punching or swung as the pale figure holds them. The pale figure's dust, sparks and blue light are the old frame's effects: do NOT draw them. Only her: no shockwaves, no trails, no dust; the blue light stays inside the gauntlet cores.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) planted straight down under her hips, its foot flat on the ground; the FAR leg (the darker one) kicked up and back behind her, bent, its foot high off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under her hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries her and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries her and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
